title: Write and Represent Inequalities
focus: Write and represent on number lines

items.stem: Which inequality correctly represents the statement: "A number x is less than or equal to 7"?
Jane has at most 10 stickers. Which inequality describes the number of stickers, s, she has? Show or explain your work.
Select ALL inequalities that correctly represent the shaded region on the number line below, where the shading starts at -3 and extends to the right, including -3.
Write an inequality for the following situation and then graph it on a number line: "A temperature t is at least 5 degrees." Show or explain your work.
